biocontainers.name: fastahack
biocontainers.summary: Utility for indexing and sequence extraction from fasta files

biotools.summary: fastahack is a library for indexing and extracting sequences and subsequences from FASTA files. The library provides a FASTA reader and indexer that can be embedded into applications which would benefit from directly reading subsequences from FASTA files.  The library automatically handles index file generation and use.
